en: Black‑and‑white postcard view of a cobbled town square bordered by old two‑ to three‑storey houses with steep tiled roofs. Signs on the ground‑floor shops are in German, and a horse‑drawn carriage stands in front of one building. People in early 20th‑century clothing walk across the square. On the hillside behind the square rises a large fortified complex with long walls, gabled roofs, and a tall church spire, suggesting a historic castle or monastery dominating the scene.
